Zero-dependency PHP micro-framework (PHP 8.4); all implementation from scratch. Always use `podman compose` commands (not Docker Compose). All PHP commands must run inside the `app` container:
`podman compose exec app php ajo <command>`
Custom test runner, NOT PHPUnit: [src/Test.php](src/Test.php).
`podman compose up -d`
`podman compose exec app php ajo test`
`podman compose exec app php ajo test --filter=Console`
